Experimental_Design.Conditions: 6 conditions (good-self, neutral-self, bad-self, good-other, neutral-other, bad-other); 2 (matching) x 2 (reference) x 3 (moral character), within-subject, self/other BLOCKED

exp3b.detail: Explicit self-referencing, blocked design: self-referencing trials and other-referencing trials in separate blocks (3 each, order counterbalanced 31/30 subjects). extraIV1 = SHAPE-side moral valence (derived from Shape text; note author's Load_save_data.r codes valence from the label-side Morality column instead - the two agree on match trials). Matching = YesNoResp. Shape = geometry file; Label = Chinese text (好我/好他/好她 etc.); other = a specific him/her (Stranger). Subject IDs verbatim (31001-31065). Table 1 N=61 (56): 4 low-accuracy + 1 manual exclusion (31003, zero hit rate in one condition) per author script.
